summary: Innate Pharma SA (Nasdaq: IPHA) filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a conference call and webcast for its Q1 2026 business update. Management roster for the call includes CEO Jonathan Dickinson, CMO Sonia Quaratino, COO Yannis Morel, and CFO Frederic Lombard. The event is scheduled for May 13, 2026, to discuss quarterly progress. No financial terms, M&A, or special-situation catalyst are disclosed. This is a routine business update announcement under Rule 13a-16 by a foreign private issuer. The filing does not trigger any special-situations classification; it is strictly a periodic operational update with no transactional or structural changes. What to watch: Standard quarterly performance review, no risk-arb angle.
